portal_description:
The cyrus-sasl packages contain the Cyrus implementation of Simple
Authentication and Security Layer (SASL). SASL is a method for adding
authentication support to connection-based protocols.

This update fixes the following bug:

* When using LDAP to look up users on IBM AIX systems, the lookup in some cases
failed. The missing support for the non-confidentiality and non-integrity layer
of the Generic Security Services (GSS) API has been added to the cyrus-sasl
library, and looking up users via LDAP on IBM AIX systems now succeeds.
(BZ#1197124) 

Users of cyrus-sasl are advised to upgrade to these updated packages, which fix
this bug.
